name: Resistor Environment QA 18
description: Multiple choice question about electricity, resistors and current QA: Potential at junctions with given resistor values and voltages.

examples.input: A junction has three resistors R1 = \SI{10}{\ohm} (with V1=\SI{20}{\volt}), R2 = \SI{5}{\ohm} (with V2 = \SI{10}{\volt}), R3 = \SI{2}{\ohm} (with V3 = \SI{-10}{\volt}). What is the potential at junction Vmid?
